recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆巨大血小板，中心為深紫色顆粒區（granulomere）、周圍淡藍色透明區（hyalomere）並有不規則突起，大小接近小淋巴球；另一顆血小板極小，整體血小板稀少，符合周邊破壞型血小板低下（如 HIV 相關）。
features: Single giant platelet with a dense purple central granulomere and a pale blue peripheral hyalomere
Irregular, spiky cytoplasmic projections of the platelet margin
Only one other small platelet in the field, indicating thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic with no schistocytes
No white cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows decreased platelets, with a single giant platelet displaying a dense purple granular center, pale blue hyalomere and irregular projections, and one small platelet elsewhere in the field. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes or spherocytes. The presence of large platelets in thrombocytopenia suggests increased marrow platelet production in response to peripheral destruction, as seen in HIV-associated immune thrombocytopenia; the finding is nonspecific and requires clinical and serologic correlation.

ddx.vs: Same blood smear appearance; distinguished by the absence of HIV or other secondary causes.
Most platelets are uniformly large, often with a family history and neutrophil inclusions in MYH9-related disease.
Contains a nucleus or nuclear fragment, unlike an anucleate giant platelet.
